name: two_b
intro: A two-stage lock. Clear both modules to escape.
manual:
PANEL MANUAL

MODULE 1 - BUTTON
Read the button's colour and word:
- If the word is GO, PRESS the button.
- If the button is red, HOLD the button.
- Otherwise, PRESS the button.

MODULE 2 - LEVERS
Two levers (left, right), each UP or DOWN:
- If the left lever is UP, pull the RIGHT lever.
- Otherwise, pull the LEFT lever.

modules.title: A single button
modules.observation: A RED button showing the word STOP.

modules.title: Two levers
modules.observation: The LEFT lever is UP and the RIGHT lever is DOWN.
